evals.prompt: Create implementation-ready specs for an enterprise runtime with adapters, queues, policy, observability, sandboxed tools, and user-facing workflows.
evals.expected_output: Creates business-to-technical specs with shared sources of truth, standards-first protocols/formats, contracts, flows, UX/frontend behavior, NFRs, useful diagrams, readiness report, and planning evidence.

evals.prompt: Review specs for enterprise gaps, custom protocols/log levels, repetition, unclear structure, and happy-path-only behavior.
evals.expected_output: Finds missing standards-first choices, custom-design rationale, source-of-truth links, unhappy paths, recovery, security/privacy, observability, performance, tests, and readiness gaps.
